summary: Jackson County, OR tower from the 1930s; Forest Lookouts dates construction to 1938. Since removed, and a business office now occupies the site.

facts.design: 50-foot creosoted round-pole tower with a 7 x 7 cab (Forest Lookouts, 1938 record)
facts.status_note: Removed, per Forest Lookouts, which says a business office occupies the tower location; the register and firelookout.com list it as gone.
facts.agency: Oregon Department of Forestry (register); Southwest Oregon Forest Protective Association (Forest Lookouts)

access.note: A business office occupies the tower location; the sources read do not say whether the public may visit.

visit.trail_note: No tower stands at the site.

events.note: Construction started March 1, 1938 (Forest Lookouts); the register dates the tower only to the 1930s

evidence.supports: register places the lookout at the ODF Central Point office and dates it to the 1930s
evidence.quote: In the 1930's a wooden observation tower was built at the ODF Central Point Office.

evidence.supports: administered by the Oregon Department of Forestry
about a mile northeast of Central Point
firelookout.com: 1930s wooden tower at the ODF office, now gone
evidence.quote: 1930s: wooden observation tower located at the ODF Central Point Office. Gone.

evidence.supports: construction started March 1, 1938; 50-foot creosoted round pole tower with 7 x 7 cab
evidence.quote: A 50-foot creosoted round pole tower with a 7 x 7 cab was started March 1, 1938.

evidence.supports: 505 man-days of labor and a cost of $1,430.74
evidence.quote: The construction required 505 man days of labor and a total cost of $1,430.74.

evidence.supports: 1938 annual report: CCC built a 50-foot log tower with an 8 x 8 cabin
evidence.quote: New 50 foot log tower and 8 x 8 cabin built by the CCC at 36S R2W 36.

evidence.supports: ten men assigned to a side camp at the Medford headquarters of SWOFPA
evidence.quote: Ten men have recently been assigned to the side camp at the Medford headquarters of the Southwest Oregon Forest Protective Association.

evidence.supports: the first project was a fifty-foot lookout tower
evidence.quote: The first of several projects, which is now under way, is the construction of a fifty-foot lookout tower
Maintenance performed: Paint cabin, creosote tower.

evidence.supports: 1955 maintenance charge for the Medford tower
evidence.quote: 1955: $8.70 spent on maintenance of the Medford tower.

evidence.supports: tower removed; a business office occupies the location
evidence.quote: Removed, the current business office occupies the tower location.

corrections.why: The FFLOS 'Built' field reads only '1930's', and no source read gives 1930. Forest Lookouts gives construction starting March 1, 1938.

notes_for_editor: The record's 1930 built year comes from the register's "1930's" decade; the only dated record is Forest Lookouts' March 1, 1938 construction start, hence the proposed correction. Owner conflict is unresolved: the register and firelookout.com say the ODF Central Point office, Forest Lookouts says the SWOFPA Medford headquarters; these may be one complex. Forest Lookouts also disagrees with itself on the cab (7 x 7 in the investment record, 8 x 8 in the annual report). No source gives a removal date. A Facebook group post in search results repeats the Forest Log text; it was not readable and is not cited. Reads: register, firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts, FFLA Oregon list (shared with the other two towers); 1 WebSearch.
